test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Rub out writing
solution: The correct answer is '**Erase**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Erase**'. • **Erase**: to remove something completely (a pencil mark, a recording on tape, a computer file, etc.) ((पेंसिल का निशान, टेप अभिलेखन, कंप्‍यूटर फ़ाइल आदि को) पूरी तरह मिटा देना) • *Example: He tried to **erase** the memory of those terrible years from his mind.* **Correct Answer:__** *Erase.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Break**: to separate, or make something separate, into two or more pieces. (टूटना या तोड़ना) • **Abolish**: to end law or system officially. (किसी क़ानून या प्रथा को आधिकारिक रूप से समाप्‍त करना) • **Demolish**: to destroy something, for example, a building. [(भवन आदि को) गिरा देना, तोड़ देना, ध्वस्‍त कर देना] 42:T675, The correct answer is '**until**'.
